title: Reference Price Basis
description: Business-declared basis of a reference price (`list_price`): what it is measured against and, where a price-indication rule shaped it, which rule. It describes the reference price sent alongside it in the same response and asserts nothing on its own.

type.description: What the reference price is measured against. Well-known values: `lowest_prior` (the lowest price the Business applied to this item, in the channel the Buyer is buying through, during `window` before the reduction took effect), `before_first_reduction` (the price applied before the first of an uninterrupted series of reductions, where the applicable rule allows it in place of `lowest_prior`), `regular` (the price the Business usually charges outside promotions), `recommended_retail` (the price recommended by the manufacturer or supplier). `lowest_prior` and `before_first_reduction` are prior-price types. A Platform MUST treat an unrecognized value as a basis that is not a prior-price type.

window.description: Length of the period, counted back from `reduced_at`, over which a `lowest_prior` reference price was taken (for example, `P30D`). A Business SHOULD include it when `type` is `lowest_prior`.

reduced_at.description: When the current reduction took effect (RFC 3339). For `before_first_reduction`, when the first reduction of the series took effect.

jurisdiction.description: Region whose price-indication rule the Business applied to the Buyer's context when choosing this reference price: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or `EU` for a rule common to the European Union. A Business MUST NOT send it unless it applied such a rule. When present and `type` is not a prior-price type, a Platform MUST NOT present the gap between `list_price` and `price` as a reduction.

display_text.description: Business-authored text that describes the reference price to the Buyer, in the language of the response (for example, 'Lowest price in the 30 days before the reduction'). A Platform that presents `list_price` MUST present this text with it unchanged, and MUST NOT present `list_price` if it cannot. It MUST NOT be used for machine logic.
